abstract.t: It was suggested at the recent network graphics meeting (@ SAIL 21-23 November) that it would be a good idea to include in the Resources Notebook information about the graphics facilities at each site. To further this proposal, I request that the Technical Liaison (or other knowledgeable person) at each site send me a description of their graphics facilities for inclusion in the Resources Notebook.
[It is not intended that this replace any other mechanism for updating Resource Notebook entries and the information collected will be submitted to the normal editorial procedures.]
